label: Teltonika TRB255
description: An industrial M2M gateway with one 10/100 Ethernet port and RS232/RS485: a 4G modem that speaks to legacy serial equipment.
notes: Vendor figures from the TRB255 datasheet: 1 x LAN port 10/100 Mbps, IEEE 802.3/802.3u; RS232 and RS485; 4G LTE Cat 4. Serial ports modelled as console interfaces, as elsewhere in the Teltonika range.
